title: Explore CR2 Raw Images
text: package implements CR2 schema described document:http://lclevy.free.fr/cr2/

title: CR2 Headers — header
text: function returns list following elements: endianness: order bites written (expecting little endian / II) magic_number: TIFF signature (expecting 42) offset_first_ifd: offset first ifd cr_marker: raw marker (expecting 'CR+2') cr_version: raw marker version offset_ifd_raw: offset first raw ifd
